article_title: Father leaves 7-year-old son alone on Mount Fuji to continue hike

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: A father was reprimanded after leaving his tired seven-year-old alone on Mount Fuji while he continued climbing
A child climbed Mount Fuji alone and won a national prize
Police closed every route on Mount Fuji because of rain
Two brothers opened a new hut near Mount Fuji’s summit
tasks.correct_answer: A father was reprimanded after leaving his tired seven-year-old alone on Mount Fuji while he continued climbing
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת באב שהשאיר את בנו בן השבע לבדו בהר פוג'י והמשיך לטפס, ולאחר מכן ננזף בידי המשטרה.

tasks.prompt: What did the father leave with the seven-year-old before continuing the hike?
options: A soft drink and a snack
A tent and a sleeping bag
tasks.correct_answer: A soft drink and a snack
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי הכתבה, האב השאיר לילד משקה קל וחטיף.

tasks.prompt: Where did mountain-hut staff find the boy?
options: At the summit beside his brother
Near the sixth station, more than 2,000 metres up
At the first station beside a police car
tasks.correct_answer: Near the sixth station, more than 2,000 metres up
tasks.explanation_hebrew: אנשי בקתת ההרים מצאו את הילד סמוך לתחנה השישית, בגובה של יותר מ־2,000 מטר.

tasks.prompt: How long was the boy reportedly waiting before he was reunited with his father?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מספרת שהילד היה עייף ונרגן לאחר שהמתין כשמונה שעות.

tasks.prompt: In the father’s apology, what does “rash decision” mean?
options: A hasty decision made without enough thought
A decision about treating a skin problem
tasks.correct_answer: A hasty decision made without enough thought
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בהקשר הזה rash פירושו נמהר או פזיז — החלטה שנעשתה בלי מחשבה מספקת.

tasks.prompt: What does “reprimanded” mean in the opening of the article?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: reprimanded פירושו שננזף או קיבל ביקורת רשמית על מעשהו.

tasks.prompt: Give two details that made the situation dangerous or worrying for the child.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שני פרטים קונקרטיים מן הכתבה שממחישים את הסיכון או את חומרת המצב.
expected_points: The child was only seven years old
He was alone on Mount Fuji
Conditions were foggy and rainy
He was more than 2,000 metres up the mountain
His father was several hours away
He waited for about eight hours

tasks.prompt: Why did police say the father should have given up the climb instead of leaving the boy behind?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את ההיגיון של המשטרה ולקשור אותו לגיל הילד ולתנאי ההר.
expected_points: A young child needs adult supervision
Foggy and rainy mountain conditions increased the risk
Continuing to the summit was less important than the child’s safety
The family could have turned back or stayed together

tasks.prompt: Summarise the sequence from the boy becoming tired to the family being reunited.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג בקצרה ובסדר נכון לפחות שלושה שלבים מרכזיים.
expected_points: The seven-year-old complained that he was tired
His father told him to wait and continued with the elder son
Hut staff found the boy near the sixth station and alerted police
Police tracked down the father higher on the route
The father returned and was reunited with the boy
Police reprimanded him and he apologised

tasks.prompt: Write a short safety message for parents hiking with children, using two lessons from this incident.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לנסח מסר ברור באנגלית ולבסס אותו על שני לקחים מן האירוע.
expected_points: Keep the group together
Do not leave a young child alone
Turn back if a child is too tired
Check weather and visibility
Put a child’s safety before reaching the summit
Seek help from hut staff or authorities if needed
